message.content: ChaeSong-hwa initiates the discussion about a karaoke night, suggesting it would be fun to mix things up and offers two possible classic songs, "Sweet Home Alabama" and "Let It Be." He emphasizes the importance of having a good time and encourages his friends to share their preferences. He expresses enthusiasm for the upcoming event, indicating that he is looking forward to seeing everyone on karaoke night and finalizing the date to ensure it has a positive vibe. The participants seem excited about the idea, with LiHua and WolfgangSchulz expressing their willingness to participate and WolfgangSchulz suggesting aiming for a Friday evening.
